tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bde blag tu rtogs byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub pa'i thabs bde blag tu rtogs byed ces bya ba/ rje btsun rin po che dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams dang / dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ dbang sngon dang mtshungs sku ni sna tshogs zhal ldan zhing / /rten 'brel dag pa'i phyag gi rgyan spras sgeg par ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rab brjid u ma'i steng / /mnyam par bzhugs pa'i he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa'i/ /rjes 'jug rje btsun gsung ji bzhin/ /dam pas bskul phyir bri bar bya/ /dbang thob dam tshig sdom ldan zhing / /byang chub sems ldan sngags sbyor shes/ /de yi lam rim mnyam gzhag dang / /spyod lam gtor ma kha zas kyi/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi yis bsdus/ /de la mnyam gzhag la bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi/ bskyed pa la bdag nyid ltar bskyed nas mchod pa dang / bzlas pa dngos gzhi yin cing / nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs pa dang / ldang ba dang khrus bskyed pa'i sngon 'gro yin la/ dag pa dran pa spyod lam gyi skabs su'ang 'jug mod kyi/ 'dir mnyam gzhag tu'ang bsdus pa'o/ /'dir bskyed pa la rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi/ dang po khrigs chags su brjod na/ stan bde ba la kha lho phyogs su bsten nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/sangs rgyas la༞ /chos la༞ /dge 'dun la༞ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas rkang pa'i mthe bong nas 'dzags/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba kar+m+maḥsu tsa me/ tsit+ta shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan he ru ka mā me muñdza/ he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/

/dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa sgrib pa nyes pa ltung ba grib ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang nyid bde mchog yab yum du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu tshogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba nyid/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /snying gi nang du a rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi steng du/ gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i sems hūm̐ du dmigs pa'i zhabs kyu bya ba grub/ khog pa so sor rtogs pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos kyi dbyings te/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung bas rtsa zhal ljang gu byung bas byang zhal/ dmar po byung bas nub zhal/ ser po byung bas lho zhal las 'phros phyogs bzhi nas brtsams te/ phyogs bcu thams cad du khyab pas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral/ bde ba bla na med pa dang mi 'bral/ chags sdang med cing 'jig rten chos brgyad btang snyoms par gyur/ su khe bha wan+tu/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ slar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ lus gang thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag 'od phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag pas thams cad bde mchog tu gyur/ 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ rang gi gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shes pad+ma gar dbang /

'du byed rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa'/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa dpal he ru ka mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna ser sna rdo rje/ kha 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus phrag dog rdo rje/ skye mched thams cad dbang phyug rdo rje/ sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu khams gsod byed ma/ me khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung khams gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ nam mkha'i khams dang pad ma dra ba can du gyur/ yang snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha' steng du bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / 'og tu 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sar+tha bī ra yo gi ni ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pad+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ne wi te āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/

sū ra sū ra/ a brta ya/ a brta ya hoḥ na maḥsaman+ta bud+dha naṃ/ a bhisma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ dhar+m+maḥdha tu ā kā sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga tā pa ri sho dha le maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi te/ pū ṇ+ye dzñā na ba len/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ba len+na/ ban+dhan pas+d+ya na ba le tsa ye swāhā/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas tshe thog ma med pa nas 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du bstsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba ci bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ /bdag dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid snying po 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la༞ /dge 'dun la༞ /bdag gi 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs blang zhing yang dag par bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang so so'i skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa de dag thams cad chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam rim pa gnyis la gnas par bgyi'o/

/bdag gis de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig rigs kyi bu khyod kyi gnas pa 'di legs par gnas pa yin gyis/ gnas pa 'dis gnas na/ mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ badz+ra muḥ snying ka'i hūm̐ las sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha gnyis dang bcas pa phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu spros pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dzā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sa gzhi de raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ me di ni badz+ri bhā wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi da na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐/ hūm̐ las sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha gnyis dang bcas pa spros/ phyogs skyong bcus gtsos byas pa'i bgegs thams cad bkug dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la bkod/ nag phyogs la dga' ba rnams tshar bcad/ phyogs skyong bcu me ri'i nang mda'i dra ba'i 'og gi rdo rje'i 'obs kyi kha khyer la bkod/ hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu dang / tho ba'i tshogs spros/ pho nya rnams la gtad/ spyi bo nas phur bus gdab/ tho bas brdungs spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal byung du phug pas srog dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sar+b+ba duṣ+ṭa na phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya sar+b+ba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra adzñā pra ti sar+b+ba bigh+nan kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ba kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ gdug pa can thams cad kyi sdig pa dag nas rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig pho nya de dag las rang 'dra'i sprul pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa spros rdo rje ra ba'i dra mig nas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing bzhugs par gyur/ phyi nang gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam du sgyu ma dang mig yor lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dhar+m+maḥswa bā wa shud+dhohaṃ/ sgyu ma'ang mi dmigs la rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ shū n+ye tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa rnams rtsegs pa'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel las grub pa/ byang gser las grub pa/ nub pad+ma rā ga las grub pa/ lho bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin las grub pa/ gru bzhi pa lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus mthing nag de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ a āḥ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥphrag gnyis g.yon skor du mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa/ ḍa ḍha da dha/ phrag gnyis g.yas skor dpe byed brgyad cu'i ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/

nyi ma'i steng du tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yum gyi mkha' dag pa pad+ma/ yab kyi byang sems mtshon pa zla ba/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba mtshon pa hūm̐ rnams rim gyis rtsegs par gyur pa'i oṃ āḥl/ de hūm̐ la/ de pad+ma/ de zla ba/ de hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu/ de khog pa/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la rim pas thim pas/ nā da dmar skya phra zhing brjid pa de ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i sgra sgrog pa 'khyog bzhin pas myur du babs te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phug hūm̐ la thim pa'i rkyen gyis thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo cig car gsal bar gyur pa'i gzhal yas khang ni/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas nag dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po'i kha khyer dang mda' yab la zla ba rlung gis skyod pa/ dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ mda' yab kyi steng du rin po che'i dra ba seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng du/ phyogs re re nas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i lha mo bzhi bzhis mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ bris pa ltar glo 'bur du gyur pa'i sgo bzhi'i rtsig pa'i steng du cung zad ma reg par ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang ri dwags dang gdugs dang ldan pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ rin po che dang me tog gi phreng ba dang / gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan par byas pa'i phyi rol du shar gtum drag byang tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/

lho 'jigs su rung ba/ me nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ srin po mun pa mi bzad pa/ rlung ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa/ dbang ldan ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ de rnams su rim pa de nyid kyis brgya byin ser po glang po che la gnas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin ser po rta la gnas pa dbyug to 'dzin pa/ chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa be con 'dzin pa/ me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mchod sbyin dang dbyug gu gsum pa/ g.yon gnyis bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa gri thod 'dzin pa/ rlung lha ljang gu sha ba la gnas pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan gyis brgyan cing rang 'dra'i rig mas g.yon nas brten pa/ spyi bos bcom ldan 'das la 'dud pa/ shing brgyad ni shi ri sha/ a shwadatha/ kaṃ ka la/ tsu ta/ ka rañdza/ la ta par ka ti/ padhi pa ta/ bha dra te shing brgyad/ de dag la rten te sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag skyong pa la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ hu lun+ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong / pad chen te klu brgyad/ sgra grags pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba/ 'bab pa/ drag po/ 'khrigs pa ste sprin brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ sprul pa'i dpa' bo/ rnal 'byor ma/ grub pa rig 'dzin/ mkha' 'gro/ mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre/ srin po/ gnod sbyin/ sha za/ ro langs/ 'byung po/ lce spyang la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus su mthing kha 'khor lo rim pa bzhi/ mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa'i dbyibs ltar/ steng ma steng ma lha so so'i pus mo re tsam gyis je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i 'khor lo rnams gzhi sngon po'i steng na rtsibs cung zad mtho bar gyur pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog 'byung ba bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam thar bzhi/ phrin las bzhi dag pas/ zhal bzhi/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon zhal ljang / rgyab zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ chos dbyings ye shes mi 'gyur ba sku mdog sngon po/ khams gsum la gzigs shing / dus gsum mkhyen pas zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog thugs su chud cing / 'pho ba bcu gnyis dag pas phyag bcu gnyis pa/ stong nyid snying rje dag pas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag dang po gnyis thabs shes zung du chud pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rmongs pa'i glang po dral bas phyag 'og ma gnyis glang po che'i lpags pa mgo g.yas su bstan te rgyangs nas gyon pa/ mchog tu dga' ba'i sgra sgrogs pas g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ nyes pa thams cad gcod pas na bzhi pa na dgra satwa/ dngos po dang dngos med kyi rnam rtog gcod pas na lnga pa na gri gug srid pa gsum gyi nyes pa 'joms pas drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ bde chen byang sems dang ldan pas g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃg bde ba chen po skyong bas bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes sems can gyi rgyud la 'ching bas lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gti mug spangs pas drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi khams la bzhugs pa dag pa'i zhabs g.yas brkyang bas myang 'das kyi mtha' dus mtshan ma dmar mo shin tu rid pa gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du mnan pa/ shes rab chen pos bdag gnyis su mi 'dzin pa dag pa'i zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'khor ba'i mtha' 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha spub tu mnan pa/ tshogs rdzogs pas ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor dgos 'dod thams cad rtsol bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa/

byang sems gong nas gong du 'phel bas g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba/ phrin las sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas/ mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan yongs su rgyas pas dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ log par lta ba 'joms pas zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ bdud bzhi 'joms pas mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ rna rgyan bzod pa/ mgul rgyan dang do shal sbyin pa/ gdu bu tshul khrims/ ska rags brtson 'grus/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsam gtan/ thal chen gyi rgya dang mchod phyir thogs shes rab ste/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ bdud bzhi 'joms pas dpa' zhing / gzung 'dzin spangs pas stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rgyas shing 'gro ba nyon mongs pas gzir ba rnams rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sems can la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar mo/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ bden gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis pa/ gdug pa can thams cad 'dul bas g.yon pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba bzung ste yab la 'khyud pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad tshar gcod pas g.yas pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ kun tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol ba skra grol ba/ nyon mongs kyi sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu/ spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ thabs dang mi 'bral bas byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ snang ba dang / thabs dang /

lhag mthong dang / snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang / shes rab dang / zhi gnas dang / bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin cing / zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun tu kha sbyor ba/ bde ba chen po rgyas pas khrag gsol ba la dgyes shing / yum gyi bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ bdud thams cad bsreg pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ tshad med pa bzhi dag pas phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃg dang thod pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng na thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas mtshan pa ste/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo gri gug gi rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thogs phub can/ rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol du thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ ka ba/ gdung / thog phubs dang bcas pa/ rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar pu li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ /byang dzā lan dha rar mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub u ḍi ya nar kaṃ ka la 'od ldan ma/ lhor ar bu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me go ta wa rir pu ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i lo can ma/ srin po ra me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rlung de wi ko ḍir rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po sa bla sbyong ba mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol du gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po pad+ma'i rwa ba/

ka ba/ gdung / thog phubs dang bcas pa/ rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar kā ma rū par aṃ ku ri dang e rā wa ti/ byang o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can la/ lho ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ba/ me ka liṃ kar rab tu bzang mo dang sh+ya ma de wi/ srin po laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dbang ldan hi ma la yar mig ma bzang dang kha ga na te gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa steng sbyong ba sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po 'khor lo'i rwa ba/ ka ba/ gdung / thog phubs dang bcas pa/ rtsigs brgyad pa'i shar pre ta pū rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang gri ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ nub so so ra ḍar rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ lho su war+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ srin po sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rlung ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ dbang ldan ku lu tar rdo rje sems ma dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar pos sa 'og sbyong ba sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa ḍa ma ru dang / g.yon gnyis pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs bzhugs tshul thams cad bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rgyan cha lugs bzhugs tshul thams cad rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa/ de'i phyi rol dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i bzhi'i lha snam shar sngo/

lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ka ba gdung thog phubs dang bcas pa'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon po mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser/ srin por gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ zhal dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu/ shin tu drag mo 'bar ba'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad khros pa'i nyams can/ sku bde ba chen pos yongs su gang ba/ dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan cing / sprul pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ lha snam gyi grwa brgyad du/ sman dang bcud sna tshogs dang / bdud rtsis gang zhing lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spud pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang / bdag gi blo la snang ba'i dkyil 'khor pho nya sngags skyes kyi rten 'di nyid/ 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa'i pho nya zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku'i gnas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa yan cing / de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku pho nya lhan skyes kyi gnas 'og min gyi zhing khams yin la/ de nyid chos kyi sku la gnad ma yin/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i brten pa/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis po 'di nyid 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi ngo bo yin zhing / de nyid 'og min gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bo yin la/ de nyid chos kyi sku'i ngo bo bdag nyid blo la snang ba'i lha sum cu so bdun po 'di nyid/

byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun po yang lha so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag go /de dag las lus rjes dran mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba rjes dran lā ma/ chos rjes dran khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ sems rjes dran gzugs can ma/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang rna chen ma/ dad pa'i dbang po su ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po rdo rje 'od dang laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma/ shes rab kyi dbang po aṃ ku ri dang e rā wa ti/ dad pa'i stobs rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ dran pa'i stobs rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de wi/ shes rab kyi stobs rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag 'jigs byed chen po rta rna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag mig mi bzang dang kha gā na/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/

yang dag pa'i lta ba pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma dang stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' khwa gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i brtsol ba khyi gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa phag gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa skyes pa ya ma dā d+dhī/ dge ba'i chos skyes pa bsrung ba gshin rje pho nya mo/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba gshin rje mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi skyed pa gshin rje 'joms ma/ de nas 'og rlung bskyod pas lte ba'i aṃ dang / steng rlung gis spyi bo'i haṃ bskul/ dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs/ snying gar 'dres pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa cig car gsal bar gyur pa/ dpral ba/ ltag pa/ rna ba gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib logs rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ klad pa zla ba/ klad rgya nyi ma/ yar gyi haṃ yig rdor sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad/ mig la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ snying gi nang hūm̐/ bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang / g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pas ḍa ma ru/

bzhi pas dgra satwa/ lnga pas gri gug drug pas mdung rtse gsum/ g.yon gyi gsum pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ bzhi pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa g.yas gnyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha spub tu mnan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ g.yon du tshes gcig gi zla ba/ mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar ro/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kun tu kha sbyor zhing khrag gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yas dang po gnyis la mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma/ g.yon gnyis la khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang gzugs spyan ma/ g.yas 'og ma bzhi na khwa gdong ma/ 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma/ phag gdong ma/ g.yon 'og ma bzhi la gshin rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma/ thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum/ phyag g.yas gnyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

mche ba gtsigs pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir/ pū/ dza/ o/ a/ go ra/ de/ ma/ ka/ o/ tri/ kau/ ka/ la/ ka/ hi/ pre/ gri/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku/ khams dang bcas pa rnams dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams su gyur pa/ spyi bo pū li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dzā lan dha rar mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa o ḍi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa ar bu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go ta wa rir sū ra we ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ra me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭir rdo rje'i 'od dang laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo/ kha dgo sngon po mkha' la spyod pa/ mchan khung gnyis ka ma rū par aṃ ku ri dang e rā wa ti/ nu ma gnyis o ṭer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / kha ka liṃ kar rab tu bzang mo dang sh+ya ma de wi/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshan dho dang / snying kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'doms bar h-i ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste nyi ma'i tshan dho/ gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa/ mtshan ma pre ta pū rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro ha ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis so so riṣ+ṭ+ra rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su war+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/

sor mo bcu drug na ga rar dpal hai ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sin dhur pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhi pa ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lor sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen ma ste nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar pos 'og na spyod pa/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ḍa ma ru dang / g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thams cad khros pa'i nyams can sku bde ba chen pos gang ba/ dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan cing / sprul pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ de ltar bsgoms pas bdag nyid phyi nang gi 'khor lo gnyis dang / sprul pa dang / longs spyod pa ste sku'i 'khor bzhi dang / de bzhin du gsung gi 'khor lo thugs kyi 'khor lo bzhi/ dpa' bo nyer lnga/ rnal 'byor ma so bdun thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sar+b+ba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko haṃ/ de dag thams cad stong pa nyid rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dho sarba dhar+m+ma badz+ra shud+dhohaṃ/ lha yab thams cad kyi thugs kar oṃ ha ra dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar dbang / phrag pa gnyis su bo'u ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mi gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ ljang gu rta mchog ste dpa' bo dang / yum rnams kyi lte bar aṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying kar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma/

khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mgo bo la hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi ka ste/ yig 'bru thams cad zla ba la gnas pa/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med pa/ phai ཾlas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ na mo sogs/ dzaḥhām̐ baṃ hoḥ yo ga shudha sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma yo ga shud+dho haṃ/ phaiṃ/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs ar+ghaṃ la sogs/ na mo sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rigs bdag tu gyur pa ni/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo lha lnga dang / dam tshig 'khor lo rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' ma/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la sar+b+ba bī ra yo gi ni ar+ghaṃ sogs/ oṃ sum+bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ dbus/ shar/ byang / nub/ lhor/ go/ ku/ da/ ha/ na las/ ba lang / khyi/ glang po che/ rta/ mi'i sha/ de dag gi steng du/ bi/ mu/ shu/ ma/ ra las/ dri chen/ dri chu/ byang sems/ sha chen gyi dngas ma/ rak+ta/ de dag gi steng du/

hūm̐/ bh+rūm̐/ kham̐/ dz+rim̐/ am̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ me long lta bu/ bya ba grub pa/ so sor rtogs pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba'i steng du/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos me 'bar ba las/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas oṃ dang hūm̐ dang zla ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ thod pa la thod pa/ bdud rtsi la bdud rtsi thim/ sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa rnams kyang thod par lhung bas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha ho hrīḥdus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru sogs/ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki ni sogs/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ pū/ dza/ o/ a/ gau/ ra/ de/ ma/ ka/ o/ tri/ ko/ ka/ la/ ka/ hi/ pre/ gri/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swa hā hu/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ/ hṛṃ moṃ/ hṛṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ nas/ kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ gyi bar/ rang gi lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ nang dang phyi'i he ru ka yab yum 'khor lo nang ma nang ma nas rim pa bzhin rje gsal du gyur pas/ dkyil 'khor dang khams gsum pa'i snod bcud thams cad shin tu gsal bar byas pas/ de thams cad cung zad g.yo ba dang bcas pa/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas snod bcud srung 'khor la/ de dur khrod la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ de sku'i 'khor lo/ de gsung / de thugs/ de snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ de gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la/ de zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsdu/ de yum yab la/ yab lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yum/ de'i yang yum yab/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐/ de yang mas rim gyis thig le la thim/ thig le de yang je phra ji phrar gyur nas/ mi dmigs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la yid mnyam par gzhag go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka yab yum du dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs te/ so dang sen mo khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li/ skra dang ba spu mahā kaṃ la/ pags pa dang dri ma kaṃ ka la/ sha mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ rtsa rgyus pu ra wi ri/ rus pa 'od dpag med/ mkhal ma rdo rje'i 'od/ snying rdo rje'i sku/ mig aṃ ku re/ mkhris pa rdo rje ral pa can/ glo ba dpa' bo chen mo/ rgyu ma rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ mnye ma rab tu bzang mo/ lto ba rdo rje bzang po/ rkang pa 'jigs byed chen po/ 'doms par mig mi bzangs/ bad kan stobs po che/ rnag chen rdo rje/ khrag rta mgrin/ rngul nam mkha'i snying po/ tshil dpal he ru ka mchi ma pad+ma gar dbang / mchil ma rnam par snang mdzad/ snabs rdo rje sems dpa'/ so dang sen mo oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ skra dang ba spu oṃ ku ru ku ru/ lpags pa dang dri ma oṃ ban+da ban+da/ sha oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ rtsa rgyus oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ rus pa oṃ hrauṃ hroṃ/ mkhal ma oṃ hrāḥhrāḥ

snying phai ཾphai ཾ/ mig oṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ mkhris pa oṃ da ha da ha/ glo ba oṃ pa tsa pa tsa/ rgyu ma oṃ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa/ snye ma oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ lto ba oṃ a kaḍh+ya a kaḍh+ya/ rkang pa oṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ 'doms par oṃ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ/ bad kan oṃ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ rnag oṃ haṃ haṃ/ khrag oṃ hiṃ hiṃ/ rngul oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tshil oṃ ki li ki li/ mchi ma oṃ si li si li/ mchil ma oṃ hi li hi li/ snabs oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rus pa'i rgyan drug oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya sogs/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo oṃ ha/ rna rgyan na ma hi/ mgul rgyan swa hā hu/ gdu bu drug bau ṣa ḍa he/ ska rags hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ thal chen dang mchod phyir thogs phaṭ haṃ/ mgul rgyan oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra bā rā hi sogs/ mgo bo'i do shal oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru sogs/ rna rgyan oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐/ glang lpags dang stags lpags oṃ sar+b+ba budha ḍā ki ni sogs/ ska rags oṃ baṃ haṃ yaṃ sogs/ phyag gi thod pa oṃ sar+b+ba budha ḍā ki ni sogs/ ya ma ma tha ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dbu rgyan gyi thod pa oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor bshad/ /thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng lha'i sku mdog lta bu byung / yab kyi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya/ mahā kalpā ga ni saṃ ni bha ya/ dza ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ daṃṣ+ṭā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya/ pa ra shu pa shu ta shū la khā ṭ+wāṃ ga dha ri ṇe/ byā gh+ra dzi nāṃ ba ra dha rā ya/ mahā dhu mra an+dha ka ra wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/

hroṃ hroṃ/ hraṃḥhraṃḥ phai ཾphai ཾ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba su ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ bi ni/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pa ta la ga ta/ bhu dziṃ gaṃ sar+b+baṃ pa/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍhah+ya ā ka ḍhah+ya/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ haṃ haṃ/ hiṃ hiṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+ba ra swāhā/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra bā rā hi baṃ/ ār+ya a pa rā dzi te/ trai lokya ma te mahā bi d+ye shwa ri/ sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he/ mahā badz+re badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te/ a pa rā dza te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri nai tra bh+ra ma ṇi sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni ka ra li ni trā sa ni/ ma ra ṇi/ sū pra bhe dha ni a pa rā dza ye dza ye bi dza ye/ dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni/ mo hā ni/ badz+ra bā rā hi mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge/ tad+ya thā/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge/ ha na ha na/ pra ṇā na/ kiṃ ka ni/ khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra haste/ sho ṣ+ya sho ṣ+ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dha ri ṇi/ mahā pi si ta mān pā sha ni/ ma nu sha an+t+ra pra bi ni/ san ni dh+yaṃ na ra si ro/ mā ma gran+thi ta dha ri ṇi/ sum+bha/ ni sum+bha/ ha na ha na pra ṇā na/ sar+b+ba pā shu nā mahā mān sa cho da ni kro dha mud+dhe daṃṣ+ṭa/ ka ra li ni/ mahā mu dre shrī he ru ka de wa s+ya/ a gra ma hi ṣi sa ha pra sha ri/ sa ha pra ba ha be/ sha sta sa ha pra mā na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khe/ piṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ne/ mi li te tsi li te/ he he/ ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu ru ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa/ a dwe te/ mahā yo gi ni/ pa thi ta/ sid+dhi/ treṃ dhaṃ/ draṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha/ bhī me ha sa ha sa bī ri ha hā/ ho ho/ hu hūm̐/ trai lokya bī na sa ni/

sha ta sa ha pra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri wa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ siṃ ha ru pe khaḥ tre lokya u da ri/ sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bi ra a twe te/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha/ mahā pa shu/ mo ha ni/ mahā yo gī shā ri twaṃ ḍā ki ni/ sarba lo ka naṃ/ ban+dha ni/ sa t+yeḥpra dha ya ka ri ṇaṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bhū ta trā sa ni/ mahā bī re/ pa ra maḥsid+dhi/ yo gī shwa ri phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ tsau ri ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ḍā ki ni ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pe ṇi ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsa k+ṣi ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra bha wa te ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā pa ya trā pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā na se hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bī ra ma ti ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kharba ri ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phai ཾphai ཾhum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dru mañtsa ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ e rā wa ti ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā bhai ra wa ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bā yu be ge hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba su ra dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba liṃ bi ni hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ra bhak+ṣi ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pa ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sar+b+baṃ pa/ tardza ya/ tardza ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sh+ya me de wi ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a kaḍa dh+ya a kaḍa dh+ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bha dre hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kha ga na ne hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra we ge hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hiṃ hiṃ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shaṇ+ḍi ni ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hum̐ hūm̐ hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warmi ni ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki le hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bi ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā ba le hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi la hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warti ni hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā bīr+ya ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kā ka s+ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lu ka s+ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā s+ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shū ka ra s+ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma da ḍi ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ṭu ti ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya daṃṣ+ṭ+rī ṇi ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ye hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ// //oṃ sum+bha/ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang ba/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sum+bha sogs/ swa bhā wa/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar/ yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ waṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa/ suṃ las ri rab/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po/ nyi ma'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pad+ma zla ba hūm̐/ de rnams rim gyis hūm̐ gi steng gi nā da la thim/ des nyi ma phug hūm̐ la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las skad cig gis rten dang brten par byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa/

rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba mda' yab dang pu shus bskor ba/ stegs bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo bcu drug mchod rdzas thogs nas mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i rtsig pa'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang / gdugs dang bcas pa/ rnga yab dang / rin po che dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo grub pa rig 'dzin/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre/ srin po/ gnod sbyin/ sha za/ ro langs/ 'byung po/ lce spyang la sogs pa du mas bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rim pa gsum pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab dmar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon mgo g.yas su gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pas ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra satwa/ lnga pas gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhag pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa/

g.yas gnyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha spub tu mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon du tshes gcig gi zla ba/ mtshog mar sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlan pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kun tu kha sbyor zhing khrag gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ka zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar du khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ /byang du mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub tu kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ mer su ra wi ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ srin por 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rlung du rdo rje 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/

dbang ldan du rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thams cad sku mdog sngon po de'i phyi rol gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar du oṃ ku ri dang e rā wa ti/ byang du rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub du dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lhor rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung ma/ mer rab tu bzang po dang sh+ya ma de wi/ srin por rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung du 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dbang ldan du mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste/ thams cad sku mdog dmar po/ de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar du/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang du rin chen dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub tu rta mgrin dang shaṇ+ḍo ni/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mer dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ srin por pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rlung du rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste thams cad sku mdog dkar po/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pas ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo lta bu'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rgyan cha lugs phag mo lta bu/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ srin por gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ rgyan cha lugs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu/ drag mo'i gzugs can ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/

thams cad khros pa'i nyams chen bde ba chen pos gang ba/ dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ lha snam gyi grar sman bcud sna tshogs kyis gang zhing lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcing pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha rgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad gsal zhing sgrib pa med pa/ snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can/ phyi nang gi sku'i 'khor lo gnyis sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags mchod phyi mchod oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sar+b+ba budha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni pradzña pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha be ta badz+ra dharmāḥhri da ya san+to sha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ aḥ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ bi ni badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ baṃ s+ya badz+ra ṇi hūm̐ a/ baṃ s+ya badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mṛ taṃ ga badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ mṛ taṃ ga badz+ra ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ murdza badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ murdza badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha s+ya badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ ha s+ya badz+ri ṇi pū badz+ra tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā s+ya badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ lā s+ya badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi ti āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gi taṃ badz+ri ṇi āḥ gi taṃ badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ nirtaya badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ nirte badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ puṣ+paṃ badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhū pe badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ dhū pe badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ dī paṃ badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ/ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dar+ṣa rū pa badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ a dar+ṣa rū pa badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/

oṃ rā sa badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ rā sa badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ spar+ṣa badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ spar+ṣa badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ dhar+m+maḥdhā tu badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ āḥ dhar+m+ma dhā tu badz+ri ṇi badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /tsakra rat+na badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren zhing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /satri rat+na badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /spu ru ṣa rat+na/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ba ngan pa rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg pa rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ga dza rat+na badz+ra/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las yongs grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /a shwā rat+na/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /'jigs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍ+ga rat+na badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med sgrub mchog stsal du gsol/ /rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan/

/shap+ta kā ma gu ṇa/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar na sogs dbang po tshim byed de/ /gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /rā sa kā ma gu ṇa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /rig bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /spar+ṣa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang chen rang bzhin sku/ /thugs rjes 'gro kun gdung sel zhing / /bdag blo'i ku mud kha 'byed pa'i/ /rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dpal ldan slob dpon sa ra ha/ /klu sgrub ri khrod mgon po dang / /lū hi pa dang dā ri ka /ghaṇ+ḍa ka tsa dzā lan dhar/ /kā rū pa dang gu h+ya pa/ /an dhar pa dang te li pa/ /nā ro pa dang pham mthing pa/ /blo gros grags pa sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun thugs rje chen po can/ /gan pa so ston ston dar dang / /chos rgyal chos rin rin rgyal zhabs/ /rab mchog dngos grub thams cad stsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyud man ngag thob pa rnams dang / sde snod gsum dang 'brel ba'i mdo gzhung 'grel thob pa'i dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can rnams kyi/ sngags rnams kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor rnal 'byorabla na med pa'i rgyud sde dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong gi sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bka' sdod srung ma rnams kyi༞ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro/ gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/

sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'gro ba sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa rnams kyi༞ rgya gar/ rgya nag li yul/ bal po la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can gyi rten dang gtsug lag khang gi srung ma rnams kyi༞ bod kyi gtsug lag khang rnams dang / bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can na gnas pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi༞ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi༞ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi༞ 'gro ba rigs drug lam brgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs/ o+oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi re sha ya sogs kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyal ba sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing / /raṃ raṃ rnam 'khor ut+pal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi/ /rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas oṃ oṃ dag par ldan/ /tshangs dang lha chen khyab mjug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan can/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ ha ha zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pas/ /mi yi seng ge dregs pa 'joms mdzad zhabs kyis gnon mdzad cing / /a la la yi sgra sgrogs bgegs rnams yongs su 'dar bar mdzad/ /cang te'u sgra sgrogs lha chen khyab 'jug stag gi lpags pa mnabs/ /thugs rjes cher sprul rab khros dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing /

/la k+ṣaṃ go ri zhabs kyis gnon cing ku tsar rab tu bzhugs/ /lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs bde gshegs dbu rgyan can/ /lha rnams kun gyi 'khor gyi 'khor los yongs skor mdzad pa po/ /hu lu hu lu dziṃ dziṃ traṃ baṃ rgyu ma thod rlon gyi/ /phreng ba 'dzin zhing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs shing khro ba yis/ /klu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs mdzad cing / /rdo rje chen po mā ma kis ni sku lus rnam par brgyan/ /dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyi 'khor lo dgra tshogs skrag mdzad cing / /ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgras gnod sbyin tshogs rnams skrag rengs mdzad/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing bī bī sha nas sku lus rnam par brgyan/ /bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni/ /ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭ kyis mdzad pa can/ /stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phro/ /phyin ci log zhen lta ngan mtha' dag ma lus med mdzad cing / /gu lu gu lu dzaṃ dzaṃ yaṃ yaṃ gis ni zhi bar mdzad/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin/ /bde ba chen po khyod ni maṃ maṃ zhes ni mdzad pa can/ /sems can don du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad pa mdzad pa po/ /ā li kī li'i rab tu sbyor ba'i sdom pa gsang ba can/ /bcom ldan mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yis/ /dpal chen he ru ka ni brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa 'di sgom phyag 'tshal ba'i/ /lha dang mi rnams gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka yi gzugs 'dzin 'gyur/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dur khrod brgyad du phog pas yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad du 'gyur/ phaiṃ/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes kyi 'khor lo cha dgu spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdakyil 'khor so so dang gnyis po gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dhar+m+maḥyo ga shudho haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dri sh+ya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ar+ghaṃ sogs oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /skabs 'dir rang rang gi chos skyong la gtor ma cho ga bzhin du dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ḍā ki ni hūm̐/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad spyan drangs dur khrod brgyad la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sar+b+ba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ ud+ma ta/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ki ni/ n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṇ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gra tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sar+b+ba karta ya sad su khaṃ bi shudhe swā hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams༞ /gnod sbyin༞ /srin po'i༞ /'byung po'i༞ /yi dwags༞ /sha za༞ /smyo byed༞ /brjed byed༞ /mkha' 'gro'i༞ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' stod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can gtum drag mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad pa/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yogs bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /srung ma rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan tot+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul lo/ /bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ lag pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar/ oṃ baṃ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ dbus mar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon ljang ba/ g.yas pa gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/ g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mdun nas g.yas skor gyis/ haṃ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang dril bu gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ drug ka'ang gcer bu g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa/ lag pas sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i dbus dang sen mo zla ba'i gdan la/ mthe bor oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/

g.yas rdo rje ḍa ma ru mgo bo/ g.yon dril bu thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mdzub mor na ma hi/ rnam par snang mdzad ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gung mo swāhā hu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ srin lag la bau ṣa ṭa he dpal he ru ka nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ mthe'u chung du hūm̐ hūm̐ hā+o ho rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser rin po che 'dzin pa/ bsdus pa'i dbus su phaṭ haṃ rta mchog ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ lnga ka'ang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas sngar gyi phyag mtshan/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ g.yas gnyis pa na ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis pa na thod pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang pas gnas pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ lhag pa la dbang ba'i 'byung po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa thams cad tshim par gyur cig bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing / /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+ma la ni rdo rjes rol mdzad cing / /bkra shis des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /srid gsum 'bar ba'i sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog /ar+ghaṃ sogs/ na mo chos dbyings sogs/ na mo bha ga wa te sogs/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal gang / /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥyo ga shud+dhohaṃ/

oṃ sum+bha ni sogs/ oṃ ha sogs/ pū dza sogs/ nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim gyi ngang la nyal lo/ /tho rangs ldang ba'i tshe nam mkha' nas ḍa ma ru'i sgra ka ra ka ra la sogs pa'i sngags su grags pas gnyid slang nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du ldang ba la sogs pa dga' ba gsum rjes su dran pa gong bzhin bya'o/ /spyod lam thams cad du bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha dang dkyil 'khor/ brjod pa dang grag pa'i sgra thams cad sngags/ rtog pa thams cad ye shes kyi 'du 'phror byin gyis brlabs nas yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad na/ snang ba lha'i rnam pa/ rang bzhin stong pa/ gnyis ka zung 'jug tu shes pa'i sgo nas spyod lam thams cad byas te rgyas par bsgom tshul lo/ /dag pa gsum dran pa'i rjes su/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ bdag bla mas dkyil 'khor du bcug phyin chad lus rten brten pa lha so bdun nam/ drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa yin snyam du bsams la/ bdag gi spyi bor bla ma dngos sam chags lham tsam bsgoms pa/ bla ma 'di nyid kho na bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo yin/ bdag gi rgyud la yon tan thams cad skye bar byed pa'ang 'di nyid yin snyam du bsams la/ gus 'dud drag po byas pas spyi bor thim par bsam/ de nas snying ka'i hūm̐ la sogs srung 'khor bsgom pa gong bzhin byas pa'i rjes su 'og rlung bskyod pas lte ba'i oṃ sogs lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab pa nas sngar ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom pa 'bring ngo / /de las kyang srung 'khor bsgom pa go cha gnyis/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur ba rnams mi byed par gzhan 'bring ji lta ba bzhin bsgom pa bsdus pa'o/ /bde mchog bde blag tu sgrub pa'i thabs/
